scope: Documented codex exec --json shapes to bounded turn events and usage candidates. Session identities are synthetic; cached and reasoning token fields are observed but not forwarded.

stream.name: thread-started-binds-session
stream.notes: The observed thread identity anchors every later line of the execution.

stream.name: turn-started-inherits-session
stream.notes: Turn lines without a session bind to the observed thread, never to a guessed run.

stream.name: agent-message-keeps-text
stream.notes: Non-message items are ignored; only model-visible text becomes a message.

stream.name: turn-completed-carries-provider-usage
stream.notes: Usage exists only when the provider reports it; completion never submits a result.

stream.name: turn-completed-without-usage-invents-nothing
stream.notes: Absent usage stays absent; it is recorded as unavailable downstream, never estimated.

stream.name: turn-failed-marks-failure
stream.notes: Failures are telemetry, not result submissions.

stream.name: error-line-marks-failure
stream.notes: String message fields on error lines do not disturb struct decoding.

ignored_noise: Blank lines and non-JSON diagnostics are ignored, matching the L03 probe behavior.
Unknown event types and non-message items produce no event and mint no usage.
rejections: Negative, fractional, missing, or out-of-range token counts fail closed.
Thread starts without a valid identity fail closed.
Self-contained lines without any observed session fail closed; ordered lines belong on one Stream.
Duplicate JSON keys and oversized lines fail closed.
